page_title: GET 0-1 ESP | Getafe v Espanyol 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Jesus Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Diego Rico (Getafe) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
90+4' Getafe fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+3' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
90+2' Abu Kamara (Getafe) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90+1' Diego Rico (Getafe) commits a foul and Jesus Manzano immediately signals a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Miguel Rubio (Espanyol) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pere Milla.
86' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
85' Abu Kamara (Getafe) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
83' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle and it's Coba da Costa (Getafe) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
83' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
83' Diego Rico (Getafe) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
82' Abu Kamara (Getafe) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
81' Substitution. Mario Martin makes his way off the pitch and Javier Munoz (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
81' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) sends a long ball forward to Coba da Costa, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
81' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
80' The free kick from long range, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' A cross from a corner kick by Getafe is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
79' Abu Kamara (Getafe) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Exposito walks off the pitch to be replaced by Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
77' Abu Kamara (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
75' A perfect long pass by Borja Mayoral (Getafe) finds Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
75' Pere Milla (Espanyol) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
73' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a long ball in, but Marko Dmitrovic comfortably gathers the ball.
72' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) plays a terrific long ball forward to Abu Kamara, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
69' Substitution. Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) in, Jofre out.
69' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Kike Garcia and he is replaced by Charles Pickel (Espanyol).
68' Mario Martin (Getafe) smashes the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after going way off target.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
67' Domingos Duarte goes off the pitch and Juanmi (Getafe) comes on.
63' Marko Dmitrovic steps in and intercepts a long pass from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
62' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
61' The ball is cleared after Kike Garcia (Espanyol) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Pere Milla (Espanyol) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
56' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abu Kamara (Getafe) replacing Kiko Femenia.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Coba da Costa (Getafe) replaces Alex Sancris.
55' Substitution. Borja Mayoral (Getafe) on for Adrian Liso.

53' 0 - 1 Goal! Exposito launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. It's 0:1.
52' Espanyol force a corner. They send men into the box.
51' Alex Sancris (Getafe) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Jesus Manzano lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
50' Jofre (Espanyol) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
49' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.

47' That was a nice football moment. Exposito (Espanyol) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. David Soria guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
45' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
44' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' Djene (Getafe) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
42' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jesus Manzano blows for a foul.
39' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' CHANCE! Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the left post.
38' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
36' Mario Martin (Getafe) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
34' The ball is behind the touchline and Getafe will take a throw-in.
33' The foul by Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jesus Manzano.
32' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) makes a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) for a tough tackle.
26' A raking crossfield pass from Diego Rico (Getafe) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

22' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
22' Exposito (Espanyol) will take the corner.
21' The referee shows a yellow card to Kiko Femenia (Getafe). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
21' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
20' Diego Rico (Getafe) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
19' Alex Sancris (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
18' Exposito (Espanyol) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of David Soria.
16' Pere Milla (Espanyol) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
16' Exposito (Espanyol) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
15' Jofre (Espanyol) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
12' Diego Rico (Getafe) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Diego Rico (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
4' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle. Pere Milla (Espanyol) commits a foul after dangerous play.
2' The Espanyol players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Espanyol will kick the game off.
Jesus Manzano got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
